messages:
maria: deploy-bot flagged elevated 5xx for embed-service v2.3.0 in eu-west1. asking for expedited push of v2.3.2 (hotfix) to mitigate.

deploy-bot: alert: 2024-07-12T07:05:00Z - embed-service v2.3.0 error-rate 4.1% (eu-west1). recommended action: patch rollout or rollback.

jonathan: oncall here. quick triage: any infra changes in v2.3.2?

maria: v2.3.2 is a small fix to backoff/retry timers. no schema or config changes. image built + scanned.

security: scan ok. no vulnerabilities.

carol: docs needs a single-line changelog before signoff.

maria: changelog: "Fix: incorrect retry timing leading to request storms under burst. No config changes." link: https://internal.releases/embed/2.3.2

ben-ops: expedited rule: we need 3 approvals + rollback criteria. propose rollback if: error-rate > 1% for 3m OR p95 latency up > 300ms for 3m.

sre-oncall: agreed. i'll own metrics & rollback. runbook: /runbooks/embed-hotfix-rollback.md. fallback: revert to v2.3.0 or shift to eu-east.

maria: preflight green. deploying: `/deploy release embed-service v2.3.2 --mode=express --ramp=10m`

deploy-bot: canary start: 3 pods (eu-west1). awaiting 3 approvals to skip extended canary. metrics: https://metrics/embed/eu-west1/canary

maria: need quick approvals, react :thumbsup: or reply.

carol: :thumbsup: docs done.

product: :thumbsup: urgent fix.

ben-ops: :thumbsup: noted rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: approve_count=3/3. scheduling ramp 0->100% over 10m starting 07:10:00Z.

deploy-bot: ramp events: 25% @07:12, 50% @07:14, 75% @07:16, 100% @07:20.

sre-oncall: watching. posting 2m snapshots.

sre-oncall: 07:14 snapshot: error-rate fell to 0.4% at 25%, but at 50% we see new spike to 1.8% and p95 up +420ms.

maria: seeing that too. rolling logs now.

sre-oncall: threshold breached for 3m window. initiating rollback per runbook.

deploy-bot: initiating rollback: reverting traffic to v2.3.0. rollback start 2024-07-12T07:15:30Z.

deploy-bot: rollback progress: 50%->0% for v2.3.2, traffic shifted back to v2.3.0.

sre-oncall: post-rollback snapshot: error-rate back to baseline, p95 normalized. continuing root-cause collection.

maria: thanks. pausing further deploys. tagging engineering to debug retry patch.

jonathan: created RL-5010 to track root cause & add regression tests. assigning to backend team.

carol: will hold docs update until patch validated.

ben-ops: expedited window closed. file a short postmortem if RCA finds rollout issue.

product: noted user impact; informing support to watch tickets.

maria: thread closed, follow-ups in RL-5010.
